title: Revised CLARITY Act Would Set Rules for Controlled DeFi Protocols
description: A revised CLARITY Act would direct the SEC and CFTC to write activity-based rules for controllers of non-decentralized finance trading protocols, while Treasury would address Bank Secrecy Act obligations.

title: Coinbase and Moov Announce Community-Bank Stablecoin Payments
description: Coinbase and Moov say they will integrate Coinbase custody and payment infrastructure into Moov's platform for its community-bank and credit-union customers.

title: SEBI Launches Demat 2.0 Pilot for Tokenised Corporate Bonds
description: SEBI's Demat 2.0 pilot uses a permissioned distributed ledger and RBI wholesale digital rupee settlement to test tokenised corporate-bond issuance, servicing and later trading.

title: ESMA Says Major Prediction Platforms Lack Required EU Authorization
description: ESMA said the marketing and sale of event contracts in the EU generally requires authorization and raised concerns about partial geographic restrictions, market integrity, contract resolution, data sources, and smart-contract execution.

title: Kalshi Plans 24/7 Tesla and Nvidia Perpetual Futures
description: Kalshi plans to seek U.S. approval for roughly 60 perpetual futures tied to individual stocks and ETFs, while the product's regulatory treatment and market-integrity controls remain unsettled.
